summary: Scoped review of the achievement-related Firestore rules: award state, pins, receipts, challenge completions and reaction attribution are server-owned; reads are restricted to the owner or family; client chat updates retain sender and family identity. A minor resource-size gap remains in the human-message senderName field. This does not certify unchanged legacy rules or production deployment readiness.

findings.issue: validMessage checks senderName is a string but does not impose a length limit. An authorized family member can submit an unnecessarily large sender name up to Firestore's document limit.
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded senderName length and matching client validation before a broader production release. Keep text length, ownership and immutable-field checks intact.
